# `/plan`

> Create a technical implementation plan from a spec. Auto-detects the feature if no argument given.

<!-- generated by scripts/gen-command-docs.py from commands/plan.md — do not edit -->

Writes the technical plan: architecture decisions, affected files, phases, parallelism notes, test strategy.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Usage** | `/plan [feature-name]` |
| **Reads** | `spec.md`, `PRD.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `DESIGN.md`, the codebase |
| **Writes** | `plan.md`; spec status → Approved |
| **Gates** | Refuses while `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION]` markers remain or acceptance criteria are not testable. |
| **Next** | `/tasks` |
| **Tools** | `Bash(ls:*), Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob` |
